risks.title: Impact of extraordinary events on attendance
risks.summary: Events such as terrorist attacks, pandemics, or civil unrest could significantly reduce attendance at our venues and disrupt operations.
risks.score_rationale: Ranked as the top external risk, with explicit mention of COVID-19 leading to full operational shutdown. Strong language on material impact and persistent threat. Category weighted as high risk due to direct exposure to global events. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Sensitivity to economic conditions and discretionary spending
risks.summary: A decline in consumer confidence or discretionary spending could reduce attendance and wagering at our facilities.
risks.score_rationale: Central risk, repeated in multiple sections with terms like 'material impact'. Direct link to consumption, inflation, unemployment, and credit availability. Post-COVID context reinforces relevance. Macroeconomic category heavily weighted. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks related to tax changes and fiscal pressures
risks.summary: Increases in taxes or fees in jurisdictions where we operate could reduce profitability and affect our financial condition.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of budgetary pressures potentially leading to new taxes. Assertive language on 'material impact'. Recurring risk in the gaming sector. Regulatory category weighted medium to high. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased competition in physical and online gaming
risks.summary: The rise of online gaming, sports betting, and new casinos intensifies competition and threatens our market share.
risks.score_rationale: Strong language on increased competition due to the expansion of legal gaming across multiple states. Major strategic risk with direct impact on revenue streams. Competition category heavily weighted. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on technology and product obsolescence
risks.summary: Failure to keep pace with technological advancements could render our wagering platforms obsolete and harm competitiveness.
risks.score_rationale: Risk tied to rapid innovation and the need to remain competitive. Mention of ability to innovate against competitors. Technology category moderately weighted but critical for the Wagering segment. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks related to equity investments and partnerships
risks.summary: Our joint investments and strategic alliances carry risks of disagreement, funding shortfalls, or loss of control.
risks.score_rationale: Mention of loss of control, disagreements, and inability to exit investments. Serious language on material impact. Capital category moderately weighted but recurring in strategic projects. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Shortage of qualified personnel and high turnover
risks.summary: Difficulty in attracting and retaining qualified employees could disrupt operations and hinder growth.
risks.score_rationale: Clear language on recruitment challenges, high costs, and operational impact. Mention of licensing requirements for key employees. Human resources category moderately weighted but critical for continuity. (default score, to be refined)
